ok.description: true only if every ruled fix was applied and staged

summary.description: What you did, in a few sentences

changedFiles.description: Every file you created or edited, each written <repoKey>:<repo-relative path>, the key one of the configured repos bound to <repos> (or workspace), e.g. frontend:src/server/app/index.js

notes.description: For each ruled fix, whether it was applied, and any diagnosis of a red suite

treesBeforeFix.description: One entry per repo you edited: the hash git write-tree printed there before your first edit. Empty when the prompt does not ask you to record them

repo.description: The repo key, one of the keys in <repos> (or workspace)
